summary.text: James Frank is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 69 who has represented the district since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: James Frank took office in the Texas House in 2013.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Human Services Committee for 2019 through 2024, and as a member of the Defense & Veterans' Affairs Committee in 2023-2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
